newest.title: The Bottleneck Behind the AI Boom
newest.description: The next AI winner may be the company that can afford the next answer. Today in The AI Edge, Alex, Jamie, and Rufus teach compute bottleneck: the constraint created when demand for intelligence outruns chips, power, data centers, or inference economics. What we covered: • Anthropic, Microsoft in talks for AI chip deal after $5 billion investment • 1Password Teams With OpenAI to Stop AI Coding Agents From Leaking Credentials • Broadcom and Meta Trigger $125 Million AI Chip Race • Precision Medicine in the Data Age: 10 Takeaways from Our WHA79 Roundtable on Health Data Governance, Trusted AI, and Equitable Access • The AI Token Pricing Crisis Behind OpenAI and Anthropic’s Revenue Race Tomorrow tension: Tomorrow’s question: who understands the compute bottleneck before it shows up in their budget, product, or job? A dynamic AI lesson through the day’s biggest stories: compute bottleneck, explained with banter, receipts, Signal or Static, and The Ledger Readout.
